g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud three-tier VM application migrated from on-premises with Migrate to VMs and DMS

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Migrate to Virtual Machines replicates the web and app VMs' disks over HA VPN
and turns each tested replica into an image
which the web and app instance templates boot from
Database Migration Service copies MySQL across the VPN
and keeps Cloud SQL in sync from the binlog until cutover
At cutover DNS points the shop at the global external load balancer
which sends requests through Cloud Armor to the web tier's managed instance group in two zones
The web VMs share uploaded content on Filestore
and call the app tier through an internal load balancer
The app VMs query the regional HA Cloud SQL instance
and reach the payment provider through Cloud NAT
